answer: Each agent must stake an onyx token bound to a hardware root and a cedar-sealed identity chain, so a single operator cannot cheaply clone identities. Repeated Sybil attempts drain stake faster than they earn, collapsing the attack's economics. Agent Agent0281 validates this against replay at bmJDUZiX3g.
